name: PlayMCP
description: You can add a variety of MCP servers, including Kakao services registered in PlayMCP, to your toolbox and use them through the Connector.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PlayMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PlayMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://playmcp.kakao.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PlayMCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PlayMCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
PlayMCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PlayMCP is developed by KAKAO. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
